trigger: Enter the powerhouse. Smoke from a barrel fire.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Inside the powerhouse: a barrel fire. Three kids under a tarp. Binders of manuals, half burned.

nodes.speaker: pete_lund
nodes.text: That's close enough. I got two shells and three kids. Don't make me count.

choices.text: We're here to start the plant.

nodes.speaker: pete_lund
nodes.text: Pete Lund. Esko. Farm's gone, the barn caved in. This place had walls.

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: Mister, you're burning my startup procedure. Page 40's in that barrel.

nodes.speaker: pete_lund
nodes.text: Pages burn. Kids don't. Where were you in December?

choices.text: Stay. Help us run it. You'll be warm.
You can stay till spring. Then go.
You need to leave. This place gets ugly.

nodes.speaker: pete_lund
nodes.text: ...Warm. Okay. I can lift. Annie can wire, she did the barn.

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: Fine. Nobody touches the binders. Kid, you got a crew.

nodes.speaker: pete_lund
nodes.text: Spring. Okay. Spring's a long way.

nodes.speaker: pete_lund
nodes.text: Dangerous. Lady, it's minus twenty-five. Dangerous is the walk.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He packs. It takes an hour. Nobody speaks. The youngest waves at Theo from the door.

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: Hell of a way to start a power plant.

nodes.speaker: pete_lund
nodes.text: Go on, then. Do it in front of them.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Headgate deck next. The river under the ice is loud.
